newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: China's WEPEC refinery in 30/40 day turnaround.
newsitem.headline: China's WEPEC refinery in 30/40 day turnaround.

text.p: China's largest Sino-foreign joint-venture refinery, the 100,000-barrels-per-day (bpd) Dalian West Pacific Petrochemical Co (WEPEC), plans a 30-to-40 day scheduled turnaround from March 10, industry sources said on Wednesday.
"(The shutdown's) from March 10...and will probably last about one month," a source familiar with the refinery said, although a WEPEC source said the turnaround might last up to 40 days.
The sources said the refinery was still not fully operational and was still undergoing test runs after being started up in September 1996.
"There were several units which did not start up in the past. The shut down is just for temporary checks," A WEPEC source said.
He only seven units were originally operated when the refinery started operations, leaving six units idle.
The sources said the turnaround had been scheduled since last year and that there were no major operational problems at the refinery.
China state-owned SINOCHEM has a 27.5 percent stake in the refinery and France's Total SA a 20-percent stake. Other Chinese companies hold the remaining stakes.
The refinery is located in northeast China and was built for exports.
